task.title: Background worker git push credentials provisioning
task.summary_zh: 解決 background worker 跑 git push 必失敗的根因。設計選項：SSH key per worker 或 GitHub PAT via env。產出 setup 腳本與 .orchestrator/ runtime 環境讀取邏輯，不直接 commit credential 本身。獨立檔案。
acceptance: worker_push_auth.md documents the chosen mechanism (SSH key or PAT) with rotation policy
setup_worker_credentials.sh is idempotent and does not echo secrets
auth_loader.py exposes load_git_credentials() returning the env vars or path needed for git push to succeed never logs the secret
test_auth_loader.py covers missing-credential fail-fast and present-credential success exit 0
no credential value committed only references
task.next: Closeout complete. Task-scoped commit c182b46a adds worker SSH/PAT credential docs, idempotent setup script, auth loader, and focused tests without raw credentials. Verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest .orchestrator/test_auth_loader.py -q => 5 passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile .orchestrator/auth_loader.py .orchestrator/test_auth_loader.py => passed; bash -n scripts/setup_worker_credentials.sh => passed; rg credential-pattern scan found only secret-manager references and test sentinel strings.
review_notes_zh: SSH/PAT機制安全，無硬編碼，文件權限驗證嚴格

handoffs.message: Ready for review: added SSH-first worker git push credential docs, idempotent setup script, secret-redacting auth_loader, and loader tests. Artifacts: .orchestrator/worker_push_auth.md, scripts/setup_worker_credentials.sh, .orchestrator/auth_loader.py, .orchestrator/test_auth_loader.py. Review approved; mechanism is safe and compliant with security rules.
